name: fibonacci_breakout_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, intraday swings of 30-80 spot points create strong institutional memory: VWAP-benchmarked desks and quant algos pre-place resting limit orders at 38.2%, 50%, and 61.8% retracement levels of the dominant 5-minute swing. When NIFTY pulls back into one of these precise Fibonacci zones, the concentrated passive buy/sell order clusters absorb directional flow and flip short-term order imbalance within 2-4 bars (10-20 seconds), producing a 15-30 spot-point reversal leg. At 5-second resolution, we can enter the moment the candle closes bullish/bearish within the Fib zone rather than waiting for a full 1-minute bar confirmation, capturing the acceleration phase of the reversal.

indicators.name: hi_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute rolling swing high. Original used 10-bar (10-min) pivot detection on 1-min bars. We compressed to 60 bars (5 min) because we're holding 30-90s and need to trade FAST micro-reversals from recent swings, not multi-hour ones. A 5-min swing captures the intraday micro-trend that generates meaningful Fibonacci clustering.

indicators.name: lo_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute rolling swing low. Paired with hi_60 to define the current dominant swing range from which Fibonacci levels are computed.

indicators.name: fib_382_bull
indicators.purpose: 38.2% retracement from the 5-min high — shallowest Fib support level. Most common bounce point when the prior trend is strong.

indicators.name: fib_500_bull
indicators.purpose: 50% retracement — psychological midpoint. Dense order clustering when trend strength is moderate.

indicators.name: fib_618_bull
indicators.purpose: 61.8% retracement — deepest valid Fib support; breach of this level invalidates the uptrend thesis.

indicators.name: mom_3
indicators.purpose: 15-second price momentum. Confirms that the candle within the Fib zone is actually starting to reverse (not still falling into the level). Original used volume confirmation; replaced with short-term momentum because index volume at 5s is too noisy.

conditions: close is within fib_tolerance * range_60 of fib_382_bull, fib_500_bull, or fib_618_bull
close < hi_60 - 0.15 * range_60 (price pulled back at least 15% from the 5-min high)
close >= fib_618_bull - tolerance (not blown through deepest valid Fib level)
range_60 > 0.15% of close (swing is large enough to create meaningful Fib clusters)
close > open (current 5s bar is bullish — bounce candle forming)
mom_3 > 0 (15s momentum confirms reversal has started)
buy_ce.confirmation: Bullish candle close within Fibonacci support zone with positive 15s momentum

conditions: close is within fib_tolerance * range_60 of (lo_60 + 0.382*range), (lo_60 + 0.500*range), or (lo_60 + 0.618*range)
close > lo_60 + 0.15 * range_60 (price bounced at least 15% from the 5-min low)
close <= lo_60 + 0.618*range_60 + tolerance (not broken through deepest valid Fib resistance)
close < open (current 5s bar is bearish — rejection candle forming)
buy_pe.confirmation: Bearish candle close within Fibonacci resistance zone with negative 15s momentum

exit.stop_rationale: A valid Fibonacci bounce on NIFTY should produce at least 8 spot points of initial reversal. If the option premium drops 4 points (equivalent to ~8 spot pts at delta 0.5), the Fib level has failed as support/resistance and the thesis is invalidated. Tighter than mean-reversion stops because Fib bounces are precise — if the level gives way, the move accelerates in the wrong direction.
exit.target_rationale: A successful Fibonacci bounce from the 38-62% retracement zone on a 30-80pt NIFTY swing typically produces a 15-25 spot point reversal in the first 60-90 seconds. 7 option points (~14 spot pts at delta 0.5) captures ~40-50% of the expected first-leg move at 1:1.75 risk-reward.

filters.vix_filter: none — Fibonacci clustering occurs in all volatility regimes
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:20 IST; skip first 10 min to let opening range establish the session's dominant swing
filters.volume_filter: implicit — swing range must exceed 0.15% of close to ensure there was real directional activity
filters.trend_filter: in_retracement filter ensures price is not making a new extreme but reversing from a prior extreme

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — Fibonacci is widely known; self-fulfilling at scale but crowded. Edge depends on 5-second entry timing advantage over 1-minute bar traders.

adaptation_notes: Original used 10-bar (10-min) pivot swing detection on 1-min equity bars with 20-60 min hold. Converted to: (1) rolling 60-bar (5-min) max/min instead of explicit pivot detection — simpler and more robust at 5s resolution; (2) replaced volume confirmation with 3-bar momentum (15s) because index volume at 5s is too noisy; (3) compressed hold to 30-90s targeting the acceleration phase of the bounce rather than the full recovery; (4) removed 161.8% extension target (too ambitious at 90s) in favor of fixed 7-pt option premium target; (5) removed trailing stop (not supported in this pipeline). Fibonacci levels remain at 38.2/50/61.8% as they are the institutional standard.
weaknesses: Rolling max/min recomputes whenever a new extreme forms — the Fib levels shift continuously rather than anchoring to a completed swing, which dilutes the self-fulfilling clustering effect
At 5-second resolution, price can briefly touch a Fib level on a wick without a true reversal forming — candle direction filter partially addresses this
NIFTY's first 10-20 minutes have erratic swings; session start filter at 09:25 partially mitigates but large gap days distort 5-minute swing Fib levels
Fibonacci levels have no mathematical basis in market microstructure — purely behavioral; institutional adoption could decrease if the edge becomes too crowded
